The following events took place in '''18 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Galen Marek]] was found by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref><ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*The [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]] occurred.
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plett]] turned his fortress in [[Plett's Well|Plawal]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] into a sanctuary for [[Children of the Jedi|fugitives]] from [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purges]].<ref name=":0">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
*[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine constructed the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''.
*[[Callista Ming]] transferred her spirit to the ''Eye of Palpatine''{{'s}} computer system.<ref name=":0" />
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] met his cousin [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]], who sold him back to [[Garris Shrike]].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
*[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] were sent to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] and her Jedi protectors were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was placed under military rule.<ref name="Battlefront-II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref><ref name="Holocron22">{{Blog|holocron|22/comments|Movie Characters killed in the EU}}</ref>
*[[Kylantha]] succeeded the late Apailana as [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo.<ref name="Star Wars Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*Darth Vader defeated all of the [[Sa Cuis]] [[Cuis clone|clones]] and defeated the rebellious [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sheyvan]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]].<ref name="ATES">{{InsiderCite|85|A Two-Edged Sword}}</ref>
*The Empire cleaned pirates out of [[Copperline]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>
*[[BIX]] and [[Gee Long]] win the [[Drainsweeper/Legends|Drainsweeper]] [[Wikipedia:Relay race|relay race]] event at the [[Roon Colonial Games]].<ref name="The Roon Games">{{DroidsCite|The Roon Games}}</ref>
